note: Phoenix technical ontology — components and data-model terms. Structural facts only; runtime state lives in Production, never here. Key dirs from .phoenix-harness/architecture-map.json.

feed-ingestor.role: Nitro relay WebSocket -> NATS Core publisher phoenix.feed.tx; ordering, duplicate/gap/out-of-order handling

phoenix-engine.role: Decision engine: prefilter -> exact state validation -> dual-provider agreement -> conservative economics -> candidate

rpc-gateway.role: Cold read gateway: provider budgets, cache, coalescing, circuit breaker, priority, dual-provider inputs. All read RPC funnels here

recorder.role: NATS engine stream -> Postgres outbox; durable delivery

replay.role: Same origin/graph/simulation/optimizer/profit modules as live, over recorded streams

live-executor.role: Constrained execution coordinator, SHADOW/SIMULATE/LIVE gates, PhoenixExecutor interaction, pause/reentrancy safety, baseline balance accounting

money-path-classifier.role: Economic gates: principal, flash premium, execution cost, ordering cost, uncertainty reserve; integer math

atlas-observer.role: Atlas auction stream observer + Aave hunter borrower screening + reconciler; Postgres sinks

migration-runner.role: Schema migrations: checksums, advisory lock, transactional apply

contracts.role: PhoenixExecutor: owner/searcher auth, pause, reentrancy guard, approved assets/pools/factories, callback checks

dataModel.opportunity: Immutable route/leg/opportunity structs; exact fee tier, pool, direction, asset, amount, min-profit
dataModel.execution_request: Attempt record (shadow/simulate/live) with authorization and lock identity
dataModel.submission: Broadcast record with nonce, signer, provider agreement
dataModel.reconciliation: Receipt + balance reconciliation -> Realized Net PnL
dataModel.ground_truth: Actual liquidation/auction events joined against Phoenix eligibility and capture (ledger tables)

coldReadRule: All read RPC goes through rpc-gateway; the hot search loop performs zero external public RPC reads.
